questions.q: Core: For 7, 10, 13, ... find (a) the 40th term (b) the sum of the first 40 terms (c) whether 301 is a term
Extend : An arithmetic series has first term 5 and the sum of its first 10 terms is 230. Find d.
Stretch : Prove that the sum of the first n odd numbers is n².
Find the nth term of 11, 8, 5, ... and its 25th term.
Find the sum of the first 20 terms of 4, 10, 16, ...
How many terms of 2, 5, 8, ... are less than 200?
Find the sum of the first 6 terms of 2, 9, 16, ...
Write the formula for the nth term of an arithmetic sequence.
